fusions.name: Wicking Strand
fusions.desc: A strand fastens on a target up to 7 tiles away that carries one of your afflictions, draws that affliction out and uses it up, and deals 8 poison damage. You heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Shed Venom
fusions.desc: Flicks the poison your strands have drawn out across a cone 4 tiles ahead of you, dealing 11 poison damage and leaving each enemy [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Drawn Through the Roots
fusions.desc: Your hair draws up to 3 poison conditions out of you through its roots and restores 8 health.

fusions.name: Bitter Run-Off
fusions.desc: Each condition laid on you has a 20% chance to run down a strand to whoever inflicted it instead.
